title: Counterpart Fairness – Addressing Systematic Between-group Differences in Fairness Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic fairness, proposing a novel fairness index (CFair) to ensure that machine learning decisions are fair and do not discriminate against specific individuals/groups. Fairness and non-discrimination are fundamental ethical principles in the context of AI decision-making, which the paper directly addresses by evaluating and improving ethical outcomes.
